Preconditions: Application deployed; seeded users exist; tester knows valid credentials
Scenario: Login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter valid username and password; 3. Submit form
Expected Result: User is authenticated and lands on SME Academy without errors; top navigation renders for authenticated user

Scenario: Reject invalid credentials
Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter invalid username or password; 3. Submit form
Expected Result: Login is rejected with a clear validation message and user remains unauthenticated

Scenario: Logout from the application
Steps: 1. Click sign out; 2. Confirm request if prompted
Expected Result: Session ends and user returns to the login page; protected pages require login again

Scenario: Request password reset
Steps: 1. Open forgot password flow; 2. Enter known email address; 3. Submit request
Expected Result: Password reset confirmation appears and email dispatch is recorded according to environment settings

Preconditions: CEO test user exists and can log in
Scenario: View the business modules dashboard
Steps: 1. Log in as CEO; 2. Open root dashboard
Expected Result: Dashboard shows grouped modules, help text popovers, available links, and business summary widgets

Preconditions: Staff test user exists and can log in
Scenario: Verify restricted module visibility for standard staff
Steps: 1. Log in as staff user; 2. Open dashboard; 3. Review visible module tiles
Expected Result: Staff user sees permitted modules only and does not see payroll or system admin if not authorized

Preconditions: User is logged in and on a module page
Scenario: Return from a module page to dashboard
Steps: 1. Open any module except dashboard; 2. Use back-to-dashboard navigation
Expected Result: User is taken back to dashboard and navigation remains consistent

Preconditions: User can open original prototype academy page if used in UAT scope
Scenario: Open Business Tools links from prototype tools section
Steps: 1. Open prototype academy tools section; 2. Click each tool card link
Expected Result: Each tool card opens the mapped live Django page without broken links
